title: Compact embedding quantization audit and cosine stability baseline
creator: Marina Patel
description: Goal: Produce deployable INT8 and FP16 quantization profiles for production embedding models and define an automated cosine-similarity drift validation workflow. Scope: calibration dataset selection, per-layer and per-channel scaling experiments, production-grade quant config format, offline and streaming eval harness, and rollout/rollback criteria tied to cosine-stability thresholds. Deliverables: (1) calibration scripts + config templates, (2) baseline vector corpus (short/long-form text + multi-lingual shards), (3) automated evaluation harness that emits per-batch cosine delta histograms and alerting hooks, (4) PR to runtime that wires selected profile into canary rollout, (5) dashboard with percentile drift stats and model comparisons.
updates: 2026-03-01: Ticket created. Initial scope defined after sync with PM and RESEARCH. Selected candidate model: embed-small-v2 (768d).

2026-03-03: Ran baseline (FP32) + INT8 dynamic-range calibration on 20k sample corpus. Observed median cosine delta 0.0016 and 99th percentile 0.035. Intuition: most regressions concentrated in short queries (<10 tokens).

2026-03-04: Experimented with per-channel symmetric quantization vs per-tensor. Per-channel reduced tail drift by ~18% at cost of ~6% slower matmul kernel on A100. Recorded perf tradeoffs in spreadsheet (link above).

2026-03-06: FP16 runs completed — negligible median drift (<0.0008) but quantized size reduction only 2x vs INT8 4x. Recommend two profiles: "compact-int8" for cost-sensitive throughput, "fp16-stable" for latency-sensitive customers. Need confirmation from PM on default selection rules.

2026-03-07: Identified a failure mode: very long documents with repeated stopwords cause KV-scale overflow in current scaling heuristics leading to cosine bias. Mitigation: clamp scale per-block and re-run calibration with longer sequences. Added follow-up task ENG-11248.

2026-03-09: Added unit tests that compare sample vectors across FP32/INT8/FP16 and assert 95th percentile cosine similarity >= 0.985 for release candidate. Tests wired into embedding-eval CI pipeline.

2026-03-10: Drafted rollout policy: start with 1% production traffic on Dedicated, monitor median/95th/99th cosine delta and top-5 nearest-neighbor rank changes. Auto-roll back if median delta > 0.005 or 99th > 0.04 for 30m window. Opened PR to runtime for canary wiring (see artifacts).
